process.title: Woodworking is not just about delivery.
process.subtitle: We work with processes
process.step1.title: 1° CONTRACT SIGNING
process.step1.text: After signing the contract, our production process begins.
process.step2.title: 2° ONBOARDING MEETING
process.step2.text: At this stage, you will meet with our team to better understand the company's processes while presenting your project, your needs, and what you want to achieve.
process.step3.title: 3° PROJECT ALIGNMENT
process.step3.text: The moment where we discuss details and aspects that will not impact the final project value.
process.step4.title: 4° PRODUCTION
process.step4.text: The GC will be responsible for carrying out the necessary measurements so that, after receiving the materials, we can begin the project's pre-assembly.
process.step5.title: 5° INSTALLATION
process.step5.text: We deliver the materials to the project location to begin the installation process. The GC will monitor the team during this stage and send weekly reports with progress photos and the updated schedule.
process.step6.title: 6° FINAL DELIVERY REPORT
process.step6.text: This represents the conclusion of the delivery, but our team will remain available to provide technical assistance whenever necessary. If there are no requests, we will carry out an inspection visit within 30 days after the final delivery.

aboutHero.title: Innovating woodworking projects through our business model
aboutHero.description: Alme presents a great difference when it comes to processes and principles. We value our processes as an important part of our journey.
aboutSection.title: Who are we?
aboutSection.text1: Alme Marcenaria was founded in 2020 by two childhood friends with the purpose of offering a safer, more organized and reliable solution for woodworking projects. From the beginning, our commitment has been to transform challenges into well-managed processes, providing peace of mind for clients and partners.
aboutSection.text2: We follow every stage of the project and work with a network of certified craftsmen, selected to ensure quality, efficiency and consistency in every delivery. With national and international operations, we mainly serve architects looking for a partner committed to excellence in every detail.
aboutSection.text3: Our way of working is guided by five fundamental values: excellence in experience, long-term thinking, commitment to our word, growth for those who accompany us and quality in everything we do. These principles guide our decisions and relationships every day.
aboutSection.text4: More than delivering woodworking projects, we seek to build trust. We want our clients to feel welcomed, safe and supported throughout the entire journey, knowing their project is in good hands.
aboutSection.quote1: Woodworking projects are not just technical deliveries. They are spaces where families will live, companies will grow and stories will be built. We do not believe excellence means the absence of failures. We believe excellence is how a company takes responsibility, faces challenges and continuously evolves. Each project challenges us to become better than we were before. This constant pursuit of improvement is part of our culture and explains why so many clients trust Alme again for new projects.
aboutSection.quote2: After all, our greatest achievement is not only delivering a completed project, but building relationships of trust that remain long after delivery.
aboutSection.author: Marcio Marques | Managing Partner
principles.title: Foundations that guide our choices
principles.excellence.title: EXCELLENCE
principles.excellence.text: We seek to carry out each stage with attention, organization and care, ensuring that the result is as remarkable as the process behind it. We follow every step from beginning to end, providing support, attention to detail and an environment designed to offer peace of mind throughout the journey.
principles.commitment.title: COMMITMENT
principles.commitment.text: We take responsibility for every project, honoring what was agreed upon and building relationships based on trust, transparency and respect. Every decision is guided by care and responsibility. We remain present throughout every stage to make the process lighter and safer.
principles.evolution.title: EVOLUTION
principles.evolution.text: We grow together with those who walk alongside us. We invest in the development of partners, collaborators and processes because we believe extraordinary results are built collectively.
principles.perennity.title: LONGEVITY
principles.perennity.text: We do not seek only the next delivery, but the next decade. We make decisions focused on lasting relationships, business strength and the positive impact we want to leave for clients, partners and our team.
timeline.description1: Every stage of our journey represents our decision to evolve. Completed projects reinforce the commitment we made from the beginning: transforming challenges into well-executed processes and delivering excellence from start to finish. This story continues to be written, one project at a time.
timeline.description2: More than producing custom furniture, we take responsibility for managing projects with planning, technical supervision and absolute commitment to what has been defined.
timeline.years.2020: Everything started before the first woodworking project. Even before opening the company, we began an intense period of research about the furniture market. We spoke with architects, clients, suppliers and craftsmen to understand the biggest challenges in the industry. Alme, originally created as Aura Marcenaria, was born from the belief that a great project depends not only on well-made furniture, but also on well-managed processes.
timeline.years.2022: The first project. The first delivery. The certainty that we were on the right path. With the beginning of operations, we completed our first contract and delivered our first project. More than manufacturing furniture, we started building a reputation based on organization, commitment and trust.
timeline.years.2024: We signed our first contract in the hospitality sector. 146 apartments and hundreds of environments executed under the same quality standards, changing the perspective and vision of the brand.
timeline.years.2025: Evolution also means knowing when to change. The market changed. So did we. We restructured our team, redefined our strategic positioning and entered a new market segment. At this moment, Aura Marcenaria officially became Alme Marcenaria. More than a new brand, a more mature company prepared for greater challenges.
timeline.years.2026: We began studying the North American market. Months of research, meetings and planning resulted in a trip to Florida to understand the sector's characteristics and build relationships. It was the beginning of our international expansion. We completed the sale and delivery of our first project executed in the United States, marking a new chapter in our history. An achievement that represents the same commitment that created the company: delivering excellence regardless of distance.

faqHero.description: We've gathered answers to the most common questions about our services and processes.
faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.description: Check out the main questions about our processes, materials, deadlines and how Alme works.
faq.questions.0.title: How does the Alme warranty work?
faq.questions.0.answer: At Alme, we provide a 5-year warranty for the structure of the furniture, starting from the installation completion date, and a 1-year warranty for hardware components, including hinges, drawer slides, pistons, sliding systems and other metallic or mechanical components. All this information is described in our contract, which is signed after budget approval and formalization of the project.
faq.questions.1.title: What is the difference between MDF and MDP?
faq.questions.1.answer1: MDF (Medium Density Fiberboard) and MDP (Medium Density Particleboard) are wood-based materials with different compositions and applications in furniture manufacturing.
faq.questions.1.answer2: MDF is produced from compressed wood fibers combined with resins, creating a more uniform panel suitable for machining, details and differentiated finishes.
faq.questions.1.answer3: MDP is produced from compressed wood particles arranged in layers with resins, mainly used for structural furniture components.
faq.questions.1.answer4: The choice between MDF and MDP is not related to one material being superior, but rather to the application, manufacturing process and specific requirements of each project.
faq.questions.2.title: How does Alme's process work?
faq.questions.2.answer1: Alme was structured with a solid foundation of well-defined and replicable processes, allowing our deliveries to maintain the same standards of quality and excellence from the beginning to the end of each stage.
faq.questions.2.answer2: All information is recorded in our systems, ensuring greater process traceability and allowing faster analysis whenever necessary.
faq.questions.3.title: Does Alme provide installation?
faq.questions.3.answer: Yes. Alme provides installation for all national projects. Installations are monitored by the RDO assigned to the project, who follows the construction process, manages documentation and ensures compliance with project quality standards.
faq.questions.4.title: How do schedules work?
faq.questions.4.answer1: Schedules are officially sent by email every Friday, ensuring transparency and clear deadline management throughout the process.
faq.questions.4.answer2: Schedules include all project stages, including material acquisition, production, installation start and completion dates, keeping everyone involved updated on the project's progress.
faq.questions.5.title: What type of hardware do we use?
faq.questions.5.answer: As our standard hardware, we use Hafele drawer slides and hinges, prioritizing concealed drawer slides due to their performance, finish and functionality. For other hardware components, we also use Rometal products, ensuring quality, durability and reliability.
faq.questions.6.title: How can I request a quote and what is the deadline?
faq.questions.6.answer1: Contact our commercial team through WhatsApp. Your quote will be sent within up to 48 business hours.
faq.questions.6.answer2: The more information provided to our commercial team during the request, the more accurate the quote will be.
faq.questions.7.title: How does project approval work before manufacturing?
faq.questions.7.answer: After signing the contract, we begin the project development and alignment stage. Projects are presented to the client and professionals involved for approval. We also perform technical visits to validate all measurements before production begins.
faq.questions.8.title: How does project follow-up work after delivery?
faq.questions.8.answer1: The inspection visit is scheduled at the end of the installation, as after the furniture starts being used, adjustments may be required.
faq.questions.8.answer2: Alme provides a technical support channel where clients can request assistance by sending photos and information about any issue. The request is analyzed and directed to the appropriate team.
faq.questions.9.title: Does Alme work with lacquer and natural wood veneer?
faq.questions.9.answer1: Yes. Alme offers flexibility regarding materials used, including lacquer finishes and natural wood veneer. Each project is analyzed individually considering technical aspects and execution feasibility.
faq.questions.9.answer2: When included in the project, we can also provide complementary elements such as glasswork, metalwork, upholstery and LED lighting solutions.

marceneiroHero.title: Grow with those who value excellence. Become an Alme Certified Partner.
marceneiroHero.description: We expand our operations through a network of certified carpenters who execute projects following Alme's standards. If you are looking for new opportunities and believe excellence should be present in every detail, we want to know your work.
marceneiroSection.title: Our approach
marceneiroSection.text:
Our process combines technical development, organization and monitoring so that each stage happens efficiently and aligned with client expectations. This way, we ensure greater predictability, standardization and safety during execution, reflecting Alme's commitment.

Certification represents more than becoming part of our partner network: it is the recognition of professionals who share our values, commitment and responsibility. We work alongside our certified partners to strengthen processes, create new opportunities and promote consistent growth for everyone involved.

With specialized management, Alme coordinates the main aspects of each project, providing greater predictability, better resource utilization and decisions that help reduce waste, optimize costs and improve delivery quality. A model that strengthens our partners and ensures consistency in every result.
